## Project recommendation

- Project name and public URL:
- Intended users, need/use case and what makes it interesting or useful:
- Original author and official subject:
- Explicit kind and one scope (`base` / `eco` / `part`):
- Evidence for that scope and checked upstream revision (Kimi development evidence is needed only for `part`):
- Documented Agent integrations or participation, if known (`agents` may be empty):
- Bilingual introduction, quick start and prerequisites:

## Checks

- [ ] One existing public project; not archived, abandoned or deprecated
- [ ] At least one Kimi scope is supported; development with Kimi is not required for `base` or `eco`
- [ ] Stable ID and publication state follow protocol v1
- [ ] Bilingual descriptions agree; claims have first-party sources
- [ ] Registry IDs valid; official means Moonshot AI only
- [ ] Validation, tests and both generators pass; generated diff included
- [ ] No runtime-testing claim unless actually performed
